body:
Took about 2 hours to kick in.  Lasted about 4 and a half hours.  Overall euphoric feeling.  Mild visuals, maybe one or two over the four hours it was in my system. Almost no pupil dilation.  Very lightheaded.  Felt like I was floating on air.  It was enjoyable.
